name: arbor
description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. author: K-Dense-AI
summary_zh: 基于假设树细化的自动优化工具，适合通过多轮实验改进代码、模型训练、智能体或数据管线，并降低对评测集过拟合的风险。
